Mary, mother of Jesus: Bikira Mariya Mutagatifu, Nyina w'Imana na Nyina wa Kiliziya, yatoranyijwe kuva kera kose ngo abyare Umukiza. Yasamwe nta cyaha kandi ni isugi iteka; yajyanywe mu ijuru n'umubiri na roho.
Our Lady of Guadalupe: Mu 1531 Bikira Mutagatifu yabonekeye Mutagatifu Juan Diego ku musozi wa Tepeyac hafi y'umujyi wa Mexico, asiga ishusho ye ku mwitero we. Ni Umurinzi wa Amerika.
Our Lady of Fátima: Mu 1917 Bikira Mutagatifu yabonekeye abana batatu b'abashumba i Fatima muri Portugal, ahamagarira isi gusenga, kwicuza, kuvuga Rozari buri munsi no kwiyegurira Umutima we Utagira inenge.
Our Lady of Lourdes: Mu 1858 Bikira Mutagatifu yabonekeye Mutagatifu Bernadeta inshuro cumi n'umunani i Lourdes mu Bufaransa, avuga ati: "Ndi Uwasamwe Atagira Icyaha." Isoko ye yabaye ahantu ho gukirira no gutagatifuzwa kuva icyo gihe.
Our Lady of Aparecida: Mu 1717 abarobyi bakuye mu ruzi rwa Paraíba ishusho nto y'Uwasamwe Atagira Icyaha, maze inshundura zabo zari zirimo ubusa ziruzura. Bikira Mariya Aparecida ni Umwamikazi n'Umurinzi wa Brezili.
Our Mother of Perpetual Help: Ishusho ntagatifu ya kera igaragaza Umwana Yezu yiruka asanga Nyina amaze kubona ibikoresho by'Ububabare bwe. Muhire Piyo IX yayishinze Abaredemptoristi mu 1866 ngo bayimenyekanishe ku isi yose.
Our Lady of the Pillar: Uruhererekane ruvuga ko Bikira Mutagatifu yaje gusanga Mutagatifu Yakobo Intumwa i Zaragoza kugira ngo akomeze ivugabutumwa rye muri Espanye, asiga inkingi nk'ikimenyetso. Ni Umurinzi wa Espanye n'abavuga icyesipanyoli.
Our Lady of Mount Carmel: Mariya nk'Umubyeyi n'Umurinzi w'Umuryango w'Abakarumeli. Yahaye Mutagatifu Simoni Stock Ishapule y'ikigina nk'ikimenyetso cy'uburinzi bwe ku bayambara bose bafite ukwemera.
Our Lady of the Rosary: Uyu munsi mukuru wibutsa intsinzi ya Lepanto mu 1571, yabonetse abakristu bavuga Rozari. Udutumira kuzirikana amayobera ya Kristu turi kumwe na Nyina.
Our Lady of Sorrows: Uhimbaza uruhare rwa Mama Mutagatifu mu Bubabare bw'Umwana we binyuze mu bubabare bwe burindwi, kuva ku buhanuzi bwa Simewoni kugeza Yezu ahambwa. Yahagaze ashikamye munsi y'Umusaraba.
Immaculate Conception: Ku bw'ingabire idasanzwe y'Imana, Bikira Mariya Mutagatifu yarinzwe icyaha cy'inkomoko kuva ku isegonda rya mbere asamwa. Ni umunsi mukuru w'umurinzi wa Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika.
Assumption of Mary: Arangije ubuzima bwe bwo ku isi, Bikira Mariya Mutagatifu yajyanywe n'umubiri na roho mu ikuzo ry'ijuru, nk'uko Papa Piyo XII yabyemeje ku mugaragaro mu 1950.
Sacred Heart: Ku wa Gatanu nyuma y'Icyumweru cya kabiri nyuma ya Pentekosti
Kwiyegurira Umutima Mutagatifu wa Yezu bihimbaza urukundo rwe rugurumana akunda abantu. Nyagasani yahishuriye Mutagatifu Margarita Mariya Alakoki amasezerano yawo mu myaka ya 1670.
Holy Family: Yezu, Mariya na Yozefu mu rugo rwabo i Nazareti, urugero ku muryango wose w'abakristu mu kwemera, urukundo no kumvira Imana.
Trinity: Iyobera nyamukuru ry'ukwemera kwacu: Imana imwe mu Bantu batatu b'Imana, Data, Mwana na Roho Mutagatifu.
Holy Spirit in Christianity: Umuntu wa gatatu w'Ubutatu Butagatifu, Nyagasani utanga ubuzima, wamanukiye Intumwa kuri Pentekosti kandi utagatifuza Kiliziya.
Christ the King: Icyumweru cya nyuma cy'umwaka wa liturujiya
Papa Piyo XI yashyizeho uyu munsi mukuru mu 1925 kugira ngo yamamaze ingoma ya Yezu Kristu mu mitima yose, mu miryango no mu bihugu byose.
Divine Mercy: Kwiyegurira urukundo rw'impuhwe z'Imana rwahishuriwe Mutagatifu Fawustina Kowalska, ruvunagurwa mu isengesho "Yezu, ndakwizera." Mutagatifu Yohani Pawulo II yashyizeho Icyumweru cy'Impuhwe z'Imana mu 2000.
Santo Niño de Cebú: Ishusho y'Umwana Yezu Mutagatifu yatanzwe igihe umwamikazi w'i Cebu yabatizwaga mu 1521, ishusho ya gikristu ya kera kurusha izindi muri Filipine.
Juan Diego: Mutagatifu Juan Diego Cuauhtlatoatzin, kavukire wicisha bugufi wayobotse ukwemera, wabonekewe na Bikira Mariya w'i Guadalupe mu 1531. Mutagatifu Yohani Pawulo II yamushyize mu batagatifu mu 2002.
Kateri Tekakwitha: "Irebe ry'Abamohawk" (1656–1680), umukobwa wayobotse ukwemera, w'isugi kandi usenga cyane, umutagatifu wa mbere w'abakavukire muri Amerika y'Amajyaruguru.
Martin de Porres: Umufurere w'Umudominikani w'i Lima muri Peru (1579–1639), wamenyekanye kubera kwita yicishije bugufi ku barwayi n'abakene b'amoko yose. Umurinzi w'ubutabera mu bantu.
Francis Xavier: Umwe mu Bayezuwiti ba mbere, yajyanye Ivanjili mu Buhinde, muri Aziya y'Amajyepfo y'Iburasirazuba no mu Buyapani, abatiza ibihumbi n'ibihumbi. Umurinzi w'ubutumwa.
Francis de Sales: Umwepiskopi wa Jenève akaba Umuhanga wa Kiliziya (1567–1622), wigishije ko umuntu wese ahamagarirwa ubutagatifu. Umurinzi w'abanditsi n'abanyamakuru.
Saint Joseph: Umugabo wa Bikira Mariya Mutagatifu n'umurezi wa Yezu, umuntu w'intungane warinze Umuryango Mutagatifu. Umurinzi wa Kiliziya yose, w'ababyeyi b'abagabo, w'abakozi n'urupfu rwiza.
Saint Patrick: Umwepiskopi akaba Intumwa ya Irlande mu kinyejana cya gatanu. Yajyanywe muri Irlande ari umucakara akiri muto, agaruka ari umumisiyoneri maze azana icyo kirwa mu kwemera.
Anthony of Padua: Umusaserdoti w'Umufransisikani akaba Umuhanga wa Kiliziya (1195–1231), umubwiriza ukomeye wakoze ibitangaza. Umurinzi w'abakene n'ibintu byatakaye.
Francis of Assisi: Washinze Abafransisikani (1181–1226), wakiriye ubukene kugira ngo akurikire Kristu kandi wahawe ibikomere bya Nyagasani. Umurinzi w'Ubutaliyani n'inyamaswa.
John the Baptist: Integuza ya Nyagasani, wabwirije kwisubiraho, wabatije Yezu muri Yorudani kandi watanze ubuzima bwe ari umumaritiri ku bw'ukuri.
Michael (archangel): Umutware w'ingabo zo mu ijuru, urinda umuryango w'Imana imitego ya Sekibi. Umurinzi w'abasirikare, abapolisi n'abarwayi.
Raphael (archangel): Malayika mukuru wayoboye Tobiya kandi agakiza Tobiti; izina rye risobanura "Imana irakiza." Umurinzi w'abagenzi n'ugukira.
Gabriel: Malayika mukuru wamenyesheje Bikira Mariya ko azaba Nyina w'Umwana w'Imana. Umurinzi w'intumwa zitwara ubutumwa.
Saint Peter: Umutware w'Intumwa na Papa wa mbere, uwo Kristu yahaye imfunguzo z'Ingoma. Yiciwe i Roma ari umumaritiri kandi aruhukiye munsi ya Bazilika ya Mutagatifu Petero.
Paul the Apostle: Intumwa y'abanyamahanga, wahindutse ari mu nzira ijya i Damasi. Ingendo ze n'amabaruwa ye byakwije Ivanjili mu isi yose y'Abaroma, yicirwa i Roma ari umumaritiri.
Saint Anne: Nyina wa Bikira Mariya Mutagatifu na nyirakuru wa Yezu, uhimbazwa hamwe na Mutagatifu Yowakimu. Umurinzi w'ababyeyi na ba nyogokuru.
Thérèse of Lisieux: Umubikira w'Umukarumelitakazi akaba Umuhanga wa Kiliziya (1873–1897), Akarabo Gato, wigishije "inzira nto" y'ukwiringira n'urukundo. Umurinzi w'ubutumwa.
Jude the Apostle: Intumwa akaba mwene wabo wa Nyagasani, umwanditsi w'Ibaruwa ya Yuda. Umurinzi w'ibibazo byihebewe.
Vincent de Paul: Umusaserdoti w'Umufaransa (1581–1660) washinze Umuryango w'Ubutumwa n'Abakobwa b'Urukundo. Umurinzi w'ibikorwa byose by'urukundo.
Thomas Aquinas: Umusaserdoti w'Umudominikani akaba Umuhanga wa Kiliziya (1225–1274), umwanditsi wa Summa Theologiae. Umurinzi w'amashuri gatolika n'abanyeshuri.
Rita of Cascia: Umugore, umubyeyi, umupfakazi n'umubikira w'Umwagustinikazi (1381–1457) wihanganiye imibabaro yihanganye cyane. Umurinzi w'ibidashoboka.
Augustine of Hippo: Umwepiskopi akaba Umuhanga wa Kiliziya (354–430), wahindutse ku bw'amasengesho ya nyina, Mutagatifu Monika. Umwanditsi w'Ibyo yiyemerera.
Saint Monica: Nyina wa Mutagatifu Agustini, wahawe ihinduka ry'umwana we abikesha imyaka myinshi y'amasengesho adacogora. Umurinzi w'ababyeyi n'abagore bubatse.
Saint Sebastian: Umusirikare w'Umuroma wiciwe ukwemera ku ngoma ya Diyokulesiyani ahagana mu 288. Umurinzi w'abasirikare n'abakinnyi.
Saint Lawrence: Umudiyakoni w'i Roma wiciwe ukwemera mu 258, werekanye abakene nk'ubutunzi nyabwo bwa Kiliziya. Umurinzi w'abadiyakoni n'abakene.
Saint Stephen: Umwe mu badiyakoni barindwi ba mbere n'umumaritiri wa mbere wa Kiliziya, wapfuye asabira abamuteraga amabuye.
Saint Nicholas: Umwepiskopi wa Mira mu kinyejana cya kane, wakundwaga kubera urukundo rwe n'impano yatangaga mu ibanga. Umurinzi w'abana n'abasare.
Saint George: Umusirikare n'umumaritiri wo mu ntangiriro z'ikinyejana cya kane, urugero rw'ubutwari mu kwemera. Umurinzi w'abasirikare n'abaskuti.
James the Great: Intumwa akaba umuvandimwe wa Mutagatifu Yohani, uwa mbere mu Ntumwa cumi n'ebyiri wapfuye ari umumaritiri. Ingoro ye i Santiago de Compostela ikurura abagenzi bo ku Camino. Umurinzi wa Espanye.
Andrew the Apostle: Umuvandimwe wa Mutagatifu Petero n'Intumwa ya mbere yahamagawe, wazanye Petero kwa Yezu. Yiciwe ku musaraba i Patras. Umurinzi wa Ekosi.
Martin of Tours: Umusirikare w'Umuroma wasangiye umwitero we n'umusabirizi, nyuma aba Umwepiskopi wa Tours (yapfuye 397). Umurinzi w'abasirikare.
Benedict of Nursia: Umubyeyi w'ubuzima bw'abihayimana mu Burengerazuba (ahagana 480–547), Amategeko ye y'isengesho n'umurimo yayoboye abamonaki mu binyejana byinshi. Umurinzi w'Uburayi.
Saint Dominic: Washinze Umuryango w'Ababwiriza (1170–1221), wiyeguriye kwamamaza ukuri na Rozari.
Ignatius of Loyola: Umusirikare wabaye umutagatifu (1491–1556), washinze Umuryango wa Yezu kandi yandika Imyitozo ya Roho, byose "ku bw'ikuzo risumbye ry'Imana."
Charles Borromeo: Arkiyepiskopi wa Milano (1538–1584) wavuguruye Kiliziya nyuma ya Konsili ya Trente kandi akita ku barwayi mu gihe cy'icyorezo.
Elizabeth Ann Seton: Umugore, umubyeyi, umupfakazi n'uwayobotse ukwemera (1774–1821), washinze Ababikira b'Urukundo n'amashuri gatolika muri Amerika. Umutagatifu wa mbere wavukiye muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika.
Isidore the Laborer: Umukozi w'umurima w'i Madrid (yapfuye 1130), wari indahemuka mu Misa ya buri munsi kandi agira ubuntu ku bakene. Umurinzi w'abahinzi.
Saint Lucy: Isugi n'umumaritiri w'i Sirakuza (yapfuye 304), izina rye risobanura "urumuri." Umurinzi w'impumyi.
Saint Cecilia: Isugi n'umumaritiri w'i Roma waririmbiraga Imana mu mutima we. Umurinzi w'abaririmbyi n'umuziki mutagatifu.
Clare of Assisi: Umuyoboke wa Mutagatifu Fransisko (1194–1253) washinze Abaklarisi, wiyeguriye ubukene n'Isakramentu Ritagatifu.
Pope John Paul II: Papa kuva 1978 kugeza 2005, wavutse yitwa Karol Wojtyła muri Polonye, umugenzi utarambirwa wabwiye isi ati "ntimutinye." Yashyizwe mu batagatifu mu 2014.
Pope Pius X: Papa kuva 1903 kugeza 1914 washishikarije guhazwa kenshi kandi akabyemerera abana bato, "kugira ngo byose bivugururwe muri Kristu."
Luke the Evangelist: Umuganga akaba mugenzi wa Mutagatifu Pawulo, umwanditsi w'Ivanjili ya Luka n'Ibyakozwe n'Intumwa. Umurinzi w'abaganga n'abanyabugeni.
Mark the Evangelist: Mugenzi wa Mutagatifu Petero akaba umwanditsi w'Ivanjili ya Mariko. Umurinzi wa Venise.
Matthew the Apostle: Umusoresha Yezu yahamagaye ngo abe Intumwa, umwanditsi w'Ivanjili ya mbere.
Bartholomew the Apostle: Umwe muri Cumi na Babiri, uwo Nyagasani yise "Umuyisraheli nyawe utagira uburyarya," wamamaje Ivanjili kandi apfa ari umumaritiri.
Helena, mother of Constantine I: Umwamikazi akaba nyina wa Konstantini Mukuru, wabonye Umusaraba nyakuri mu rugendo rutagatifu rwe i Yeruzalemu.
Brigid of Kildare: Umukuru w'abihayimana b'i Kildare (yapfuye ahagana 525), wakundwaga kubera urukundo rwe no kwakira abashyitsi. Umurinzi wa Irlande.
Louis IX of France: Umwami w'Ubufaransa (1214–1270), umutegetsi w'intabera wiyeguriye isengesho n'abakene.
